## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Added examples are deliberately synthetic; no customer data, credentials or generated runtime artifacts are included.
- [ ] Scheduling changes include semantic, negative and corrupted-output tests, or this does not change scheduling semantics.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and identified any contribution-rights question for maintainer review.
